extraction.IsA: class or type membership: [dog, IsA, animal]
extraction.InstanceOf: named entity is an instance of a class: [parma, InstanceOf, city]
extraction.HasProperty: attribute, state or cardinality: [coat, HasProperty, red] ; [man, HasProperty, two]
extraction.CapableOf: the subject performs the action: [person, CapableOf, jump]
extraction.NotCapableOf: the subject does NOT perform the action: [politician, NotCapableOf, attend_meeting]
extraction.ReceivesAction: the object undergoes the action: [ball, ReceivesAction, kick]
extraction.AtLocation: spatial location: [man, AtLocation, park] ; [jump, AtLocation, street]
extraction.UsedFor: purpose or instrument of an action: [knife, UsedFor, cut]
extraction.HasSubevent: sub-action happening within the action: [cook, HasSubevent, stir]
extraction.MotivatedByGoal: action done for a goal: [train, MotivatedByGoal, competition]
extraction.MannerOf: specific way of doing (verb-verb): [sprint, MannerOf, run]
extraction.HasContext: temporal or contextual setting: [sleep, HasContext, night]
